settings.title: Settings
settings.reducedMotionDesc: No screen shake, FOV kick or pulsing; calmer effects.
howto.title: How to play
howto.goalText: Eat glowing energy to grow longer. Make rivals crash their head into your body, then feast on what they leave behind. Your score is the peak length you reach in a single life.
howto.mouse: Mouse: the worm follows your cursor. Hold left or right click to boost.
howto.keys: Keyboard: A/D or ←/→ to turn, Space, W or ↑ to boost, Esc or P to pause.
howto.touch: Touch: drag anywhere on the left to steer, hold the right side to boost.
howto.pad: Gamepad: left stick to steer, A or RT to boost, Start to pause.
howto.boost: Boosting spends length. It leaves a trail of energy others can eat.
howto.celestialsText: Swallow a celestial body to gain a permanent power for this life. It becomes a glowing segment of your body. A green ring means you can eat it; a red number is the length you need.
howto.asteroid: Asteroids are solid. Touching one is fatal.
howto.gate: Energy gates flash orange, then switch on. They are fatal while lit.
howto.well: Gravity wells slow you and pull you in.
howto.rim: The glowing arena rim is fatal. A shield saves you once from any of these.
howto.teamText: Pass through your teammates harmlessly. The team with the greater total length when time runs out wins. You respawn after each life.
loading.slow: The network is slow. Play now with simplified visuals, or keep waiting.
howto.feastText: Chain bites to build a Feast combo; milestones pay bonus stardust. Rare prismatic Nova Motes are worth ten motes. The longest worm wears the Bounty Crown — devour the wearer to claim it and its stardust bounty.
hint.asteroid.title: Asteroid
hint.asteroid.text: Solid rock: touching it is fatal. Steer around the red striped ring.
hint.gate.title: Energy Gate
hint.gate.text: Fatal while lit red. It flashes amber before firing; cross when it is dim.
hint.well.title: Gravity Well
hint.well.text: Not fatal, but it slows you and pulls you in. Boost out or go around.
hint.rim.title: Arena Rim
hint.rim.text: The striped red edge of the arena is fatal. Turn back before you reach it.
hint.rival.title: Rival Worms
hint.rival.text: A red ring marks rivals you can't bite: their bodies are walls. ▲ means longer than you, so they win head-on clashes.
hint.ally.title: Teammates
hint.ally.text: In Team mode, blue rings mark allies. You pass through them safely.
tip.asteroid: Tip: asteroids sit inside red striped rings. A red reticle appears when you are on course to hit one.
tip.gate: Tip: gates flash amber before they fire. Wait for them to go dim before you cross.
tip.rim: Tip: the red striped band marks the arena edge. Turn early; the minimap shows how close you are.
tip.worm: Tip: rival bodies are walls. Follow the red reticle and edge arrows to spot them early.
tip.head: Tip: rivals marked ▲ are longer than you and win head-on clashes. Cut across their bodies instead.
tip.self: Tip: your own body is a wall too. Leave room to turn, and avoid tight spirals while boosting.
settings.threatsDesc: Full adds badges, a look-ahead reticle and edge arrows. Minimal keeps ground marks and colours only.
hint.edible.title: Edible celestial
hint.edible.text: A gold ring (gold on the minimap too) means you are big enough to swallow it for a permanent power.
hint.bite.title: Bite through smaller worms
hint.bite.text: Gold ring and ▼ mean you can bite their body: hit it with your head to cut them in two. Eat the spilled food.
multiplayer.title: 3 v 3 friend match
multiplayer.description: Create one room and share the blue link with two friends. Your rival can share the red link with two more friends.
multiplayer.inviteHint: Share one link per team. The match needs three connected ready players on each side.
multiplayer.running: The online arena is running. Your worm is controlled by the match server.
multiplayer.unavailable: Online play is not configured. Set VITE_MULTIPLAYER_URL or multiplayer/bootstrap.json to a running WebSocket server; local play still works.
skins.customize: Mix any owned palette with a free color and head. Cosmetics do not change your team or crown.
skins.head: Head shape
surprise.zone.desc: Adds 28 to the arena radius for 18 seconds. A warning appears 5 seconds before it returns; heads outside the returning rim are rescued.
surprise.legendary.desc: Permanently adds 14 to this arena radius, up to 84 bonus units per match. Temporary zone expiry never removes it.
surprise.shrink.desc: Reduces physical size for 12 seconds without losing length, score, powers or crown eligibility.
trap.freeze.desc: Stops movement and boosting for 1.6 seconds.
trap.slow.desc: Cuts movement speed to 48% for 4 seconds.
trap.reverse.desc: Inverts keyboard, pointer and AI turning for 3.5 seconds.
trap.half.desc: Halves current length/score (minimum 4). Powers in the removed tail are lost; historical records and stardust are kept.
trap.teleport.desc: Moves the whole worm to a safer location with brief landing protection. Length and powers are kept.
howto.specialsText: The crown, 90+ length/score or 4 kills unlocks rare gold-ring drops near a dominant worm. Eat one within 5 seconds; anyone may steal it. Only one appears at a time, with 30–80 seconds between drops depending on dominance.
howto.trapsText: Red outlined traps trigger only when your mouth touches them; magnets cannot pull them. Players and bots follow the same rules. A shield blocks one trap; spawn protection and effect duration + 2 seconds of recovery prevent trap chains. Each planet/core stack reduces timed traps by 15%, up to 45%.

multiplayer.reconnecting: Connection lost — reconnecting (seat reserved for 60 seconds)…
multiplayer.testHint: Development room: at least one ready player per team; every occupied seat must be connected and ready.
multiplayer.resultsHint: Server results: food earns points, eliminations earn 50. Local records and stardust are unchanged. Create a new room to play again.
multiplayer.errors.multiplayer_unavailab: Start the Node/ws server and configure its actual URL. HTTPS clients require WSS.
multiplayer.errors.invalid_room: Enter a valid room code (5–8 letters or digits).
multiplayer.errors.clipboard_denied: Clipboard access failed. Open or copy the invitation link shown in the room.
multiplayer.errors.protocol_mismatch: Client/server versions differ. Refresh the client and deploy the v2 match server.
multiplayer.errors.seat_replaced: This seat was resumed in another tab. Leave and join another seat.
multiplayer.errors.connection_rejected: Could not connect. Check the server URL, allowed origins and available seats.
multiplayer.errors.resume_expired: The 60-second reconnection window expired. Leave and create or join a new room.
multiplayer.errors.invalid_server_messag: An invalid server packet was ignored. Check that both client and server run v2.
multiplayer.errors.room_create_failed: The server could not create a room. Try again after checking connectivity.
multiplayer.errors.not_ready: Only a seated player can change readiness before the match.
multiplayer.errors.not_ready_to_start: Only the host may start, after all required players are connected and ready.
multiplayer.errors.invalid_input: An invalid or duplicate control packet was ignored by the server.
multiplayer.errors.invalid_message: The server ignored an unsupported message.
multiplayer.peerDescription: Free, casual peer-to-peer multiplayer. Firebase provides signaling; one player hosts the simulation. Not anti-cheat. Server/local modes remain available.
multiplayer.peerHint: Invite 1–3 players per team. All other seated players must be connected and ready; Start readies the host automatically. Keep the host tab visible.
multiplayer.peerRunning: The elected browser host decides movement, collisions and scores. P2P is not anti-cheat; no local records are modified.
multiplayer.errors.peer_config_missing: P2P needs real Firebase web settings: copy .env.example to .env.local, fill all VITE_FIREBASE_* fields, enable Anonymous Auth + Realtime Database, publish firebase.database.rules.json and rebuild. Server/local play still works.
multiplayer.errors.peer_auth_required: Enable Authentication → Sign-in method → Anonymous in your Firebase project, authorize this domain, then retry. Check signup quotas if blocked.
multiplayer.errors.peer_room_unavailable: Could not create/join this P2P room. Check the room code, real database URL and published Firebase rules; ask the host for a fresh invite.
multiplayer.errors.peer_rules_denied: Firebase signaling was denied or failed. Publish firebase.database.rules.json to the correct Realtime Database and check Anonymous Auth/network/quota.
multiplayer.errors.peer_not_supported: This browser does not support WebRTC DataChannels. Use a current browser or server/local mode.
multiplayer.errors.peer_connection_faile: Peer connection is not ready. Try another network or server mode: restrictive NAT/firewalls may require a TURN relay, which is not included in free P2P.
multiplayer.errors.peer_invalid_stun: VITE_PEER_STUN_URLS must be comma-separated stun: or stuns: URLs. Clear it to use the default STUN server.
multiplayer.errors.peer_signaling_offlin: Firebase signaling disconnected; authority is paused until a valid host lease is confirmed.
multiplayer.errors.peer_migrating: Waiting for a valid host lease / deterministic host migration. Keep this tab open.
multiplayer.errors.peer_migrated: Host changed. The latest available snapshot was restored; play resumes (best-effort, not exact RNG continuity).
multiplayer.errors.peer_resync: No usable migration snapshot was available. A new P2P round started; old round scores were reset.
multiplayer.errors.peer_room_expired: This P2P room expired after 24 hours. Leave and create a new room.
multiplayer.peerResultsHint: Results reported by the P2P host, not an anti-cheat server. Local records and stardust are unchanged. Create a new room to play again.
multiplayer.peerMatchLoading: Loading arena state from the P2P host…
